# [Drone Flight Simulator Controls Demo](https://app.airtimetools.com/recorder/s/z_e3yFnQTV9lqUeuYBPoxu?t=0)

This demo showcases a 3D drone flight simulator, built with three.js, allowing users to test various drone controls. The map features a predefined route overlaid on a realistic terrain model.

## [Basic Route Playback](https://app.airtimetools.com/recorder/s/z_e3yFnQTV9lqUeuYBPoxu?t=28)

When `play` is activated, the drone automatically follows the mock route, moving sequentially between points on the map.

​[![Drone flying along a marked route on a 3D map](https://dvfh9gnetfwo1.cloudfront. "Drone flying along a marked route on a 3D map")](https://app.airtimetools.com/recorder/s/z_e3yFnQTV9lqUeuYBPoxu?t=43)​

## [Adjusting Playback and Latency Settings](https://app.airtimetools.com/recorder/s/z_e3yFnQTV9lqUeuYBPoxu?t=35)

The settings panel provides controls to manage playback speed and progress, as well as a latency control to simulate delays in drone responsiveness.

​[![Settings panel showing playback and control latency options](https://dvfh9gnetfwo1.cloudfront. "Settings panel showing playback and control latency options")](https://app.airtimetools.com/recorder/s/z_e3yFnQTV9lqUeuYBPoxu?t=50)​

## [Switching to First-Person View](https://app.airtimetools.com/recorder/s/z_e3yFnQTV9lqUeuYBPoxu?t=77)

Users can switch from the overhead map view to a first-person perspective, experiencing the flight from the drone's point of view, with the route overlay optionally disabled.

​[![First-person view from the drone's perspective over a field](https://dvfh9gnetfwo1.cloudfront. "First-person view from the drone's perspective over a field")](https://app.airtimetools.com/recorder/s/z_e3yFnQTV9lqUeuYBPoxu?t=121)​

## [Gimbal and Zoom Controls in Flight](https://app.airtimetools.com/recorder/s/z_e3yFnQTV9lqUeuYBPoxu?t=93)

While flying, the gimbal can be controlled using arrow keys to look in different directions, and zoom functionality is available. A reset button restores the default view.

​[![Drone's first-person view showing fields and distant houses with camera movement](https://dvfh9gnetfwo1.cloudfront. "Drone's first-person view showing fields and distant houses with camera movement")](https://app.airtimetools.com/recorder/s/z_e3yFnQTV9lqUeuYBPoxu?t=155)​

## [Taking Manual Control of the Drone](https://app.airtimetools.com/recorder/s/z_e3yFnQTV9lqUeuYBPoxu?t=132)

Manual flight can be initiated by pausing the simulation, which reveals direct movement and altitude controls. Alternatively, simply starting to move the drone while on an automatic route will automatically pause it.

​[![Drone view while being manually controlled over a field next to a road](https://dvfh9gnetfwo1.cloudfront. "Drone view while being manually controlled over a field next to a road")](https://app.airtimetools.com/recorder/s/z_e3yFnQTV9lqUeuYBPoxu?t=210)​

## [Manual Flight Controls](https://app.airtimetools.com/recorder/s/z_e3yFnQTV9lqUeuYBPoxu?t=166)

Use WASD for forward, backward, and strafing movements. Q and E keys control altitude (up and down), while arrow keys allow for continuous gimbal control.

​[![Drone's manual movement over a barren field next to a road](https://dvfh9gnetfwo1.cloudfront. "Drone's manual movement over a barren field next to a road")](https://app.airtimetools.com/recorder/s/z_e3yFnQTV9lqUeuYBPoxu?t=250)​

## [Resuming the Automatic Route](https://app.airtimetools.com/recorder/s/z_e3yFnQTV9lqUeuYBPoxu?t=154)

To return to the predefined route, press play again. The drone will automatically navigate back to its last point on the route and continue the programmed flight.

​[![Drone flying back towards a road and fields to resume its route](https://dvfh9gnetfwo1.cloudfront. "Drone flying back towards a road and fields to resume its route")](https://app.airtimetools.com/recorder/s/z_e3yFnQTV9lqUeuYBPoxu?t=300)​

## [Using the "Fly To" Feature](https://app.airtimetools.com/recorder/s/z_e3yFnQTV9lqUeuYBPoxu?t=212)

Clicking anywhere on the map sets a target for the drone to fly to. This feature can be used during manual flight or to interrupt an automatic route. The drone initially approaches the target without locking.

## [Locking Onto a Target and Orbiting](https://app.airtimetools.com/recorder/s/z_e3yFnQTV9lqUeuYBPoxu?t=239)

Once a target is selected, activate "lock on target." This locks the gimbal to the target. Forward/backward controls now zoom in/out, and left/right controls enable orbiting around the target. Altitude adjustments automatically adjust the gimbal's vertical view.
